title: Add two numbers
prompt: solve receives two numbers, a and b. Return them added together.
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	return 0
hint: Inside the function, a and b are ready to use like any variable.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	return a + b
